description_en: Retrieves a token for a group enterprise to use as an authorization credential when calling APIs to access data of subsidiary enterprises within the group
description_zh: 集团企业通过本接口获取 token，调用接口获取集团内子企业数据时，需要使用该 token 作为授权凭证
kebab_example: aliyun btripopen group-corp-token --corp-id open1200000000i07v10wDzRSK9w00 --sub-corp-id btrip00000000cs286734u_mow6q --app-secret ZzljczY5d00000000xlcjVTKnVoZS0 --x-acs-btrip-access-token - --api-version 2022-05-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GroupCorpToken

parameters.description_en:
The subsidiary enterprise ID.
- **View permission:** Only enterprise administrators have view permission.
- **View path:** Log on to the [Enterprise Management Console](https://admin.alibtrip.com/home/BtripIndex?s=api#/home) as an **enterprise administrator** > Parent-Child Account Management > Account Management > Child Account Management > Company ID.
